title: Come Ye Souls by Sin Afflicted
lyrics_original: Come ye souls by, sin afflicted,
Through the cross, behold the crown;
Take His easy, yoke and wear it;
Love will make your, obedience sweet;
Christ will give you, strength to bear it,
While His grace, shall guide your feet
Blessèd are the, eyes that see Him,
Blest the ears that, hear His voice;
Blessèd are the, souls that trust Him,
Sweet as home to, pilgrims weary,
Like full springs in, deserts dreary,
Is the rest, the cross supplies;

bible_verses.english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
The next day, John saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold! The Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come to You tired of trying to carry my own heavy burdens. Thank You for taking my sin upon the cross and offering me Your endless mercy instead. Help me to fix my eyes on You today and rest in Your grace. Teach me to walk in Your light yoke, trusting that Your love will supply all the strength I need. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Carrying the weight of our own mistakes and striving to measure up leaves us weary and brokenhearted. But Jesus invites us to stop looking at our shortcomings and look instead to the cross, where His mercy flows freely. His call is not to add more burdens to our lives, but to trade our heavy sorrow for His light and gentle yoke. As we fix our eyes on Him, His love transforms our heart, making obedience a sweet expression of gratitude rather than a heavy chore.
